description: Rajas con Crema is a beloved Mexican vegetarian dish featuring tender strips of roasted poblano peppers bathed in a rich, creamy sauce. This comforting and flavorful preparation offers a delightful balance of smoky heat and velvety texture, making it a perfect side dish or a satisfying main course. Experience the authentic taste of Mexico with this easy-to-follow recipe, bringing a taste of tradition to your table.

instructions.title: Roast and Peel Poblano Peppers
instructions.text: Roast the poblano peppers over an open flame, under a broiler, or on a hot comal until the skins are completely charred and blistered. Immediately place the hot peppers into a plastic bag or a bowl covered tightly with plastic wrap for 10-15 minutes to steam. This makes the peeling process much easier.

instructions.title: Prepare the Rajas
instructions.text: Once the peppers have cooled enough to handle, remove them from the bag. Carefully peel off the charred skins, then cut each pepper lengthwise, remove the seeds and veins, and cut the flesh into 1/2-inch wide strips (rajas). Set aside.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or frying pan over medium heat. Add the sliced white onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.

instructions.title: Add Corn and Peppers
instructions.text: Stir in the corn kernels and the prepared poblano rajas into the skillet. Cook for 3-5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the corn to warm through. If using fresh corn, cook until slightly tender.

instructions.title: Create the Creamy Sauce
instructions.text: Pour in the Crema Mexicana (or thinned sour cream) and whole milk. Stir gently to combine all ingredients. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, but do not allow it to boil vigorously, as this can cause the cream to curdle.

instructions.title: Simmer and Season
instructions.text: Reduce the heat to low and let the Rajas con Crema simmer for 5-7 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly and the flavors to deepen. Season generously with salt and black pepper to taste. Adjust seasoning as needed.

instructions.title: Serve and Garnish
instructions.text: Remove the skillet from the heat. Serve the Rajas con Crema hot. Garnish with crumbled Queso Fresco and fresh chopped cilantro, if desired. Enjoy immediately with warm tortillas, as a side dish, or as a filling for tacos or quesadillas.

tips: To perfectly roast your poblanos, char them over an open flame, under a broiler, or on a hot comal until skin is blistered. Immediately place them in a plastic bag or covered bowl to steam for 10-15 minutes, which makes peeling effortless.

For the most authentic flavor, use Crema Mexicana. If unavailable, a good quality sour cream thinned with a little milk will work, but Crema Mexicana has a unique tangy and slightly thinner consistency that is ideal.

Rajas con Crema is incredibly versatile. Serve it as a side dish with tacos, enchiladas, or grilled meats, or enjoy it as a vegetarian main course with warm tortillas or rice. It also makes a fantastic filling for quesadillas or tamales.
